Robert Petre, 9th Baron Petre
Robert Edward Petre, 9th Baron Petre (March 1742 in Ingatestone Hall – 2 July 1801) was a British peer. Lord Petre was the son of Robert Petre, 8th Baron Petre (1713–1742), a renowned horticulturist, and Lady Henrietta Anna Mary Barbara Radclyffe (1714–1760), daughter of the 3rd Earl of Derwentwater (1689–1716) who was the grandson of Charles II by his mistress Moll Davis. Lord Petre was a member of the English Roman Catholic nobility, a philanthropist and responsible for employing James Paine to design a new Thorndon Hall and a house in Mayfair.
